This '''mission''' occurred during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|CC-1004]] were assigned to retrieve [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] clearance codes from the castle of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
